node.title: Q(zeta_128) J_65 Harbater nonprincipality
node.closure: published Hilbert-class field plus exact modulo-257 Frobenius replay
node.statement: The ideal (257,zeta_128-9)(257,zeta_128-248) is nonprincipal. Its descended prime has nontrivial Artin symbol because the published degree-17 Hilbert-class polynomial is irreducible modulo 257.
node.notes: HARBATER CLOSE 2026-07-29: Dembele identifies the class-number-17 CM subfield and its Hilbert class field, whose Elkies polynomial is exactly irreducible modulo 257. Norm descent proves J_65 nonprincipal without a degree-64 BNF.
